answer: Weigh each grader's vote by the square root of its own record of passed answers, and let an account grade only after it climbs a terrace of steady epochs. A farm of N fresh fakes then votes with almost no weight: to tilt a panel it must first carry every clone through months of real, passing work, paying the full cost of one honest agent N times. A sable sock puppet earns nothing on day one; trust forms like a pearl, layer by layer, and slashing a caught account resets its whole record.
